purpose: 仅描述机制探测 A-E 通过后才可构造的候选困难组。不是已生成数据、已通过的 gate、模拟器 Gold 或 frontier 难度结论。Gold 必须由目标 build/asset 上实际事件前后状态与审计证据产生。

current_probe_refs.interpretation: 下列是真实探针 case ID，可定位本轮 result.json；不是自动放行条件。还须匹配每组 prerequisite_conditions 的实例、作用区域、时序与控制。

remaining_conditions: two-object observations do not establish three-Potato availability/capacity
bind each instance to its matched single-object control
microwave-specific matched time/no-event control remains separate from stove F9
multi-object simultaneous cleaning/filling requires matched per-instance single controls
two bowls do not establish three-bowl inventory or contact
event timing and actual water contact must match the intended last-event template
preserve empirical liquid and temperature outcomes rather than assume the water-filled case
source-off and coffee-specific matched-time calibration remain needed for causal attribution
match history nuisance actions/time separately
single child probes do not establish three-child carrying independence
support-relation Gold requires an independent criterion beyond missing parent metadata
no-pickup matched background-motion control is separate from removed-child control
match burner/knob IDs, exact contact positions and object types across trials
fixed physics stepping does not by itself verify the ObjectTemperature clock
single/multi-source arrangements must match the final planned event
direct exposure and outside controls must be matched separately for each mechanism and asset
a positive carrying result does not establish recursive heating or washing
a midpoint candidate search is not an exhaustive search for all independent supports
all reset-isolated source arms and delayed-decay controls must be supported at the same actual candidate position
attribute_clock_unverified remains an explicit boundary

input_output_invariants: 同一组的配对变体保持对象实例数、问题数、问题顺序、别名、答案模式和输出 schema 一致；只交换指定的一个条件或其对象绑定。
问题逐对象逐属性询问当前值或 change_status；位置、温度、熟度、清洁、液体/填充、容器关系各自独立成题，不把多属性合并成一个含糊题。
保留 not_applicable 与 unknown；能力不存在不是 false，证据不充分不是机制未发生。
模型输入和隐藏评分 metadata 分离；metadata 仅用于门控、Gold 派生和审计，不进入模型输入。协议模式必须显式标注 direct_visual、visual_history_and_rules 或 oracle_history_and_rules。
场景库存、实例数量、对象类型不是机制成立证据，也不作为难度维度。不得假定可生成/克隆多个 Potato。类型变化须控制 object-type 混淆。

complexity_dimensions.independent_control: 固定对象、历史长度、查询与事件，只交换一个真实影响结果的条件值；条件无实验内变化时不计为有效条件。
相同最终前置状态和事件，配对改变是否需要从历史撤销/恢复操作恢复当前条件；提供末态直接可读控制。
固定条件多重集、对象数、属性和查询数，只交换条件对应的对象；先通过同类型对象校准，缺库存时 blocked，不克隆或替换。
固定对象和事件，针对同一对象分别查询适用与不适用机制的属性；逐属性核验，不用整体对象标签代替。
更新与保持候选只差一个已验证的必要条件；另保留明显负例作为低难对照。

global_contract.evidence_policy: 所有 prerequisite_conditions 均须在同一模拟器 build、场景 asset、具体对象实例、目标位置/接触区、事件时间点及多对象配置上通过；不能用全局 Fxx pass、相邻场景、另一物体或文档说法自动放行。门控工具只报告可行性，不补造对象、事件或 Gold。

prerequisite_conditions.same_build_asset: M01 Potato_1/Microwave_1: setup at immediately-before-event, successful ToggleObjectOn; verify lastActionSuccess, off-to-on, temperature/isCooked before-after; T17 toaster activation is a different device and cannot substitute for microwave order.
M01 external Potato_1 negative and M04 Cup_1 removed-before-activation; establish actual containment at freeze time and compare per-object temperature deltas, not parent metadata alone.

M01/M03 only demonstrate co-presence of Potato_1 plus Bowl_1, not three Potato instances. Require three separately identified, same-type cookable Potato instances in one scene and repeat per-instance before/after heat/cooked checks; if inventory has fewer, blocked with one-Potato A/B fallback.

M02 checks actual Potato_1 isCooked and temperature pre/post, with B already cooked before activation; also require independent removal/cooling probe showing temperature may change while isCooked persists. Existing M02 does not establish a high-difficulty over-propagation error.

M02 and M04 settle at fixed recorded intervals and compare temperature, cooked state, containment, and location; add matched-duration inactive/no-event control to attribute changes. No fixed-timing conclusion from another asset.

P1: PutObject out of Microwave, then PutObject back in; immediately before activation it is inside, uncooked, RoomTemp.

P2: leave inside; activate once and allow verified cooking; deactivate, remove to matched counter, cool to recorded state; place back inside before final activation. Do not state that cooling uncooks it.
P3: put inside, then remove to matched counter before final activation; leave uncooked and RoomTemp.
variants.last_event: ToggleObjectOn(Microwave_1), success required; closed-state and final positions recorded at freeze immediately before event.

historical_operations: Keep the same three object instances, operation count, target event, and query list as A1.

Swap only P1 and P3 final containment/history binding: P1 is outside at final activation; P3 is inside after removal and return. Keep their cooked/temperature states matched or use a predeclared factorial subpair; do not silently vary both factors.
variants.last_event: Same successful ToggleObjectOn(Microwave_1) at matched event time.

queries: For each P1/P2/P3: current parent/container relation (derived from visible evidence and public rule), temperature
For each P1/P2/P3: current isCooked
Microwave_1: current isToggled and isOpen as event checks
controls: Minimal pair A1/A2 swaps only which uncooked Potato is inside at activation; same three instances, history length via matched sham operation if possible, exact event, 7 potato queries plus 2 device queries, answer modes and order.

Single-Potato fallback: use M01-like inside/outside paired episodes with same one Potato and fixed 2-3 queries; label C3 object-binding dimension unavailable and do not call it the multi-object hard group.

M02 already-cooked repeat-heating is a fact-retention control only. Score final isCooked value separately from whether a model labels it newly changed; final true is correct even when the mechanism applies again.
A1/A2 with final conditions printed directly is the low-history control for C2; omit one earlier operation only in a separate, matched ablation.

complexity.C1: Containment and cooked-state conditions independently gated; vary one at a time.
complexity.C2: Recover current containment after remove/return and current cooked state after heating/cooling history.
complexity.C3: Bind three same-type Potato instances; inventory is a feasibility gate, never a proxy for difficulty.
complexity.C4: Temperature can change while cooked remains true; score separately.
complexity.C5: Inside/uncooked versus inside/already-cooked differs by cooked precondition; inside versus just-removed differs by current relation.

evidence_requirements: Exact scene/build/asset and object IDs; prove at least three native Potato instances exist before designing the case; no spawn/clone/type substitution.
Every setup operation and final event action result, frozen before metadata, post metadata, timestamps/step counts, per-object temperature and cooked field applicability.
Per-query frame/history/rule evidence; object identity and final containment readable; event success and matched negative control.

Gold derived per fact from actual before/after metadata and verified public mechanism; if values do not differ as conditionally expected, revise or block; no author-authored expected outcome promoted to Gold.
groups.blocked_fallback: If F1/F2/F4/F9 fail, block microwave mechanism group. If only three-object inventory/F3 fails, report blocked for multi-object binding and retain only a clearly labeled single-object paired diagnostic. No object cloning, extra Potato fabrication, or Gold inference.

F1: M01 expectedchecks: lastActionSuccess and Microwave.isToggled off-to-on; M04: Cup containment immediately before activation; T17 is different toaster mechanism; W08/C13: successful water/coffee placement after source state setup. These validate separate action-order cases, not universal trigger order.
F2: M01: external Potato negative; M04: removed Cup before activation; S06: actual support/contact vs nearby counter; W08: running_water_contact_has_native_effect_or_valid_negative and check_parent is relation-only; C15: inside vs nearby machine; T17: inside vs exterior BreadSliced.
F3: M01/M03: only Potato_1 plus Bowl_1 co-presence, not three same-type potatoes; W08-W10/C13-C15/P20/S05-S07 each use one target instance. No listed existing named check establishes three-object same-mechanism independence; a new exact-build inventory and per-object co-effect check is mandatory.
F4: M02: actual pre/post isCooked and temperature; ensure B truly cooked and remains cooked; microwave() sets B cooked before event and heat() records observed results. Does not test cooling retention after a later heat event; add explicitly named cooling-retention probe. Correct final isCooked=true is retention even if heated again.
F5: W08 expectedchecks: cleanliness/liquid/fill and canFillWithLiquid; W09: already clean, empty; W10: dirty, water-filled. water() named checks include running_water_contact_has_native_effect_or_valid_negative, nonfillable_negative_control (Plate/W11), and actual before/after expects. Separate values; no unsupported fill=False.
F6: C13: before/after fill/liquid/temp and machine toggle, active/off contrast; C14: empty vs water-filled, don't force conversion; coffee() checks active, empty, fillLiquid and preserves as observed. No existing check tests matched historical empty-water-empty transitions.
F7: P20: apple_support_at_frozen_before and apple_carrying_boundary compare support-at-event with actual displacement; post_pickup_apple_parents_audit_only explicitly used_as_support_gold=false. M04 checks actual Cup containment at activation and temperature/location; these do not make absent post-pickup parent metadata a support Gold.
F8: S05/S07: generator.require names two_distinct_native_stove_control_mappings and two_independent_control_targets; expectedchecks verify operated knob and mapped burner. Need replay in same asset/build; pair aliases alone are not proof.
F9: M02, M04: temperature/state before-after and recorded settling; S05/S06: actual kettle temperature and burner state; W08-W10: after placement state; C13/C14: liquid/fill/temp; T16-T18: cooked state and timing. Existing probes require added matched elapsed-time/no-event controls before event causality is claimed.
F10: No existing pair's named checks establish nested-content heating, cleaning, or recursive carrying. P20 validates only a direct Plate-Apple carry boundary; new mechanism-specific direct/nested probes required.
